scenario.title: Research study: how students get help with their writing
scenario.intro: A researcher from the university writing center is interviewing students about how they get feedback on their writing.

questions.text: To start, could you tell me what kinds of writing you usually do for your classes, and how often you have a written assignment due?
Can you describe a time when someone's feedback helped you improve a piece of writing? What did they suggest, and what did you change?
Some people believe that every first-year student should be required to visit the writing center at least once. Do you agree or disagree, and why?
How do you think the way students get help with their writing will change over the next ten years, and why?
